final: WITH s AS (SELECT t.equipstatus AS st, AVG(g.pulsepersec) AS a FROM signals g JOIN telescopes t ON g.telescref = t.telescregistry GROUP BY t.equipstatus HAVING AVG(g.pulsepersec) IS NOT NULL), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s), k AS (SELECT st, a FROM s, m1 WHERE a > m1.m), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k), f AS (SELECT k.a AS a FROM k, m2 WHERE k.a > m2.m) SELECT AVG(f.a) AS avg_final, AVG(f.a - m1.m) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(f.a - m2.m) AS avg_excess_second FROM f, m1, m2
